verdict_a_product_acceptance.finding: The acceptance guard uses geometry measured from the live sidepanel DOM. It catches the recorded document overflow (391/360), displacement (31/-31), result-list viewport overflow, and missing/clipped result tabs; its test also accepts six contained tab controls. This proves the guard path from source, not that the product fix passes in the loaded Chrome artifact.
verdict_a_product_acceptance.guarded_run_readiness: One guarded native run is ready against the supplied CI candidate (run 37193761291, artifact 11299613935), after the native owner records the exact imported extension path/version/tree-hash receipt required by docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. This reviewer did not launch Chrome or claim a native pass.
verdict_a_product_acceptance.remaining_limit: The geometry sample includes title and capture-row rectangles, but the current guard predicates do not assert those rectangles; native screenshots/click evidence remain separate. This was already a minor source limitation in the prior review.

verdict_b_reload_retention_quality.finding: The repair preserves the existing bounded timeline in the outer catch for thrown Error objects, reusing current old/replacement target IDs, pre-click presence, latest owned snapshot, drop count and retirement predicate. It does not change the worker-retirement acceptance predicate.
verdict_b_reload_retention_quality.actual_receipt_wiring: reloadOwnedExtension rethrows the same error after attaching lifecycleEvidence; runNativeResourceAction awaits and propagates it without wrapping; the Scrape acceptance catch calls captureLifecycleEvidence(error.lifecycleEvidence) and stores reload_lifecycle_failure before writing the JSON receipt. The sanitizer accepts only fixed fields, capped timestamps/IDs/types/kinds, at most 80 entries and 16 targets; it drops arbitrary URL/title/content data.
verdict_b_reload_retention_quality.failure_path_review: The shared catch covers click rejection, later CDP target polling, replacement-panel polling/lookup, context observation and post-reload management errors. A failure during reload.click retains observed target events even when no post-click target poll was reached. Existing management diagnosis is spread into the resulting evidence before the new timeline is attached.
verdict_b_reload_retention_quality.test_quality: The focused click-failure test runs the actual reload helper with external CDP/UI dependencies controlled by the fixture, emits target lifecycle callbacks, then throws from the trusted-click stand-in. It asserts the rethrown code, old target identity, event phases/order and sanitized absence of extension URLs. A plant.py mutation disabling the catch made this test fail with the expected click failure; plant.py restored the harness byte-identically (SHA-256 a6fe920da985867fa46db0912700f4d174b9c52296d62abf823fc4569608e1cc).
verdict_b_reload_retention_quality.limitations: Only the click-failure case is injected as a throwing failure; CDP poll/panel attach and management failure coverage follows from the common catch and source trace, not separate test injections. No native run was performed.
